primitives.meaning: several independent churn-relevant signals crossing a defined threshold together: sustained meaningful usage decline, a failed renewal or payment, a negative support experience, repeated unresolved blockers, explicit dissatisfaction, exploration of cancellation, a key stakeholder leaving, falling account-wide adoption
entryFilters: several independent churn-relevant signals crossing a defined threshold together: sustained meaningful usage decline, a failed renewal or payment, a negative support experience, repeated unresolved blockers, explicit dissatisfaction, exploration of cancellation, a key stakeholder leaving, falling account-wide adoption
no instance of this journey is already open for the customer
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.asks: Has explicit cancellation intent already been expressed?

branches.label: Already cancelling
branches.test: a cancellation has been requested or a cancel flow entered

branches.label: No stated intent
branches.test: the risk is inferred from behaviour and events, and nobody has said anything

primitives.on: cancellation intent already on record when risk escalates
carries: the risk evidence, which is context for the conversation rather than a second conversation
suppresses: any separate retention track for this relationship while the cancellation decision is live

primitives.does: Assemble the signals with their sources and strengths. What matters is whether they corroborate each other, not how many there are - three readings of the same underlying event are one piece of evidence

primitives.asks: Is the risk driven by a known operational problem?

branches.label: Known problem
branches.test: the evidence points at something specific that is broken or unresolved

branches.label: No known problem
branches.test: the relationship is deteriorating and nothing identifiable is causing it

primitives.on: risk with an identifiable operational cause
carries: the risk evidence and which part of it names the problem
the fact that this is already at risk level, so the cause-specific recovery knows what is at stake
suppresses: promotional retention offers on this relationship until the problem is resolved

primitives.asks: Does the evidence justify a person?

branches.label: Justified
branches.test: the evidence is strong and corroborated, and the relationship warrants the cost of someone's attention

branches.label: Not justified
branches.test: the evidence is real but thin, and putting a person on it would be a larger intervention than the signal supports

primitives.does: Raise a task for the account owner or customer success, carrying the evidence rather than the score, and suppress automated retention on this relationship so the person is not contradicted by a sequence while they work

primitives.on: risk strong enough to justify a person
carries: the assembled evidence, so the first conversation is informed
what has already been sent, so it is not repeated in person

primitives.asks: Is a proportionate automated recovery available?

branches.label: Available
branches.test: something exists that matches the evidence at this strength

branches.label: Nothing proportionate
branches.test: the only available responses are larger than the evidence justifies

primitives.on: a proportionate automated retention intervention being delivered
carries: the evidence it was chosen against
the risk state at the time it was sent

primitives.state: risk recorded, nothing proportionate to do
primitives.reEntry: stronger or fresher evidence re-opens this at a higher level - doing nothing is a legitimate response to weak evidence, and doing something disproportionate is not
